name: EPIC 212136170
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 5, 20.8 solar radii and 2.39 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 212136170 (K2 campaign 5): PARAM radius (solar radii) 20.832983 (16th-84th percentiles 19.497406-21.952052), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

text.card: A red giant 5,704 parsecs away, 21 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 5, give 2.39 solar masses and 20.8 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,690 K at its surface.
